name: io.github.Nero-Engine/removals-pack
title: Removals Pack
description: Move volume, van size, quotes by postcode, storage and checklists for UK removals firms' AI

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Lists Removals Pack's tools, item and room allowances, vehicles, default rates and what it deliberately does not do. Needs no input.

tools.name: estimate_move_volume
tools.description: Sizes a move from a property type ("3 bed semi"), a list of rooms or an item list (or any mix). Returns cubic feet and cubic metres with each line of working, a likely box count split small, medium and large, the vehicle (small_van, lwb_van, luton, 7_5_tonne, 18_tonne) with the number of loads and fill percent, the licence it needs, items that need two people, and furniture to dismantle. Allowances are indicative; pass ft3 or m3 on any item or room for your own. Example: {"property":"3 bed semi","items":[{"item":"piano_upright"}]}.

property.description: Whole home in plain words, for example "3 bed semi", "2 bed flat", "studio", "4 bed detached". Uses an indicative allowance for typical contents.

contents.description: How full the home is, for property: light (x0.8), normal (default), full (x1.25).

rooms.description: Rooms instead of (or as well as) a property. Each {"room":"double_bedroom","count":2}; add "ft3" to use your own figure. Rooms: living_room (250 ft3), dining_room (150 ft3), kitchen (150 ft3), master_bedroom (250 ft3), double_bedroom (200 ft3), single_bedroom (120 ft3), home_office (120 ft3), bathroom (20 ft3), utility (50 ft3), conservatory (80 ft3), hallway (30 ft3), garage (150 ft3), loft (150 ft3), garden_shed (60 ft3).

tools.name: quote_move
tools.description: Prices a move between two UK postcodes. Takes the volume (volume_m3 or volume_ft3, or the same property, rooms and items inputs as estimate_move_volume), access at each end (floor, lift, parking distance, narrow access), packing (none, fragile, full), dismantling, and the firm's own rates. Returns crew size, load, unload, drive and dismantle hours, vehicle and loads, road miles and drive time (postcodes.io map points, straight line x 1.3 road factor, said in the answer; or give distance_miles), fuel, every price line, a low to high price range, London ULEZ, LEZ and Congestion Charge, Clean Air Zone, Scottish LEZ and Dartford Crossing flags, drivers' hours warnings, and which UK defaults were used where no rate was given. Example: {"property":"2 bed flat","from_postcode":"LS6 2AA","to_postcode":"YO1 7HH","from_access":{"floor":2,"lift":false},"labour_rate_per_person_hour":28}.

tools.name: storage_estimate
tools.description: Works out storage for a move: the self storage unit in square feet (from 10 to 500 sq ft) or the number of removals storage containers, with the monthly and total cost from the firm's own rate. Takes volume_m3 or volume_ft3, or the same property, rooms and items inputs as estimate_move_volume. Defaults (labelled in the answer): stacking height 8 ft, 80% of the floor used, £2.25 per sq ft a month, £18 a container a week. Example: {"property":"3 bed semi","months":3,"rate_per_sqft_month":2.1}.

tools.name: move_checklist
tools.description: Makes a customer facing moving checklist from 8 weeks before to after the move, in plain words the firm can send as it is: decluttering, boxes, parking and lift booking, utilities, Royal Mail redirection, council tax, DVLA licence and V5C, electoral register, essentials box, freezer, meter readings and damage reporting. With move_date (YYYY-MM-DD) every stage gets its date and stages already past are flagged. Returns `stages` (structured) and `text` (ready to paste). Uses the firm name and phone from `trade`. Example: {"move_date":"2026-12-18","packing":"fragile","new_home":"flat_with_lift"}.

tools.name: trade_profile
tools.description: Checks the removals firm's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1: trading name, Companies House number, trade body and number such as BAR or NGRS, postcode, contact, Nero Work services) and returns them cleaned, with a stable `nero_trade_ref` computed from the trade body membership or company number. The same object, given as `trade` to the other tools, prefills their answers. Removals Pack stores nothing. Also returns `join_nero_work`: how the same profile signs the business into Nero Work (category removals), the UK job exchange used through AI assistants where the firm sends its own customer a held Stripe pay link and pays 2% only when paid.
